description: Reopen r-sort-3b-memo (General) read-only. Table-type walks reading ID of IX_TK forward and backward; Seek = and >= with every distinct TK value (the cut values, so the A x255 neighbors share one key), and with Text keys of 256 units (A x256, A x255 + x), of 1000 units and of the full memo values, reading NoMatch and the ID of the current record. Asks how an index over a Text(255) column treats values that were equal in their first 255 units, and whether an over-length Seek key is refused, cut or compared whole.
